title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE AND CATEGORICAL EXEMPTIONS relative to the Eighth Amendment to the Amended and Restated…
text:
[Council File 19-0468-S1; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE AND CATEGORICAL EXEMPTIONS relative to the Eighth Amendment to the Amended and Restated Agreement with Wabtec Transportation Systems, LLC, for continued operation, maintenance, support, and enhancement of the Port Optimizer platform at the Port of Los Angeles.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. ADOPT the determination by the Board of Harbor Commissioners that the proposed action is administratively and categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) and Article III, Class 6(2) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Port of Los Angeles Resolution No. 26-10796 authorizing the Eighth Amendment to Amended and Restated Agreement No. 26-3425-H with Wabtec Transportation Systems, LLC, extending the contract term by three years through November 3, 2029, and increasing the not-to-exceed compensation by $14,781,600, for a total not-to-exceed amount of $56,332,020, for continued operation, maintenance, support, and enhancement of the Port Optimizer platform.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer reports that there is no impact on the City's General Fund. Approval of the proposed Eighth Amendment will increase the not-to-exceed compensation under the Agreement by $14,781,600, from $41,550,420 to $56,332,020. Funding of $3,184,800 is budgeted in Account 542025 (IT Implementation & Consulting Services), Division 50010 (Information Technology). Funding for future years will be requested and budgeted as part of the Harbor Department's annual budget process. Financial policies The City Administrative Officer reports that the proposed recommendations comply statement with the Harbor Department's adopted Financial Policies.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 12, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 11, 2026
